name: Unclean Thoughts
overview: Scripture reveals that unclean thoughts originate in the heart, which is the source of both life and defilement. Jesus teaches that even lustful intent is equivalent to committing adultery in the heart, highlighting the seriousness of inward purity. The heart must be diligently guarded and renewed by God to maintain a clean and right spirit, as evil thoughts and sinful actions flow from it and defile the person.
